reuse.why: The tree already exports getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts with exactly this rule (used by forecast, schedules app and shared code), but the diff writes a private getExpectedScheduleAmount instead of calling it.

duplication.why: getExpectedScheduleAmount is a line-for-line copy of shared getScheduleAmount (null -> 0, number -> itself, range -> endpoint with larger absolute value).

placement.why: Adding the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is the right layer, but the amount rule is placed as a private helper in api-models.ts rather than taken from shared/schedules where the tree keeps it.

scope.why: Only the API type, the model mapping and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: A second private copy of the expected-amount rule will silently drift from the shared helper the rest of the server uses.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in api-models.ts is getScheduleAmount from shared/schedules.ts under a new name
